title: Who is a culture fit?
subtitle: Who belongs at each company — in their careers pages' own words
intro: Every careers page implies an ideal worker. Read side by side, they fall on a spectrum: from belonging-first ("everyone can belong and thrive") to an explicit elite filter ("it's hard to work here if you're not a great match"). Here is who each company says fits, in its own words.
caveat: These are careers-page self-descriptions — how companies say they choose people, not how they actually do. Summaries are interpretation; quotes are verbatim.

cards.summary: Belonging-first: a diverse mix of identities and interests where everyone is meant to fit.

quotes.text: We seek to host employees who express a diversity of cultures, interests, thinking, and identities.
Just like each listing is unique, so is each person, and we work to build a culture where everyone can belong and thrive.

cards.summary: Talented, but framed as inclusive — the most talented people in a place where everyone belongs.

quotes.text: We believe in hiring the most talented team members and creating an environment where everyone belongs.
A diverse, equitable, and inclusive culture helps people achieve their best work, be themselves, and build innovative products.

cards.summary: Smart, passionate generalists from diverse backgrounds — defined by enthusiasm, not a filter.

quotes.text: We put great stock in our employees — energetic, passionate people from diverse backgrounds with creative approaches to work, play and life.
We believe in hard work, a fun atmosphere, and the sort of creativity that only comes about when talented people from diverse backgrounds approach problems together.

cards.summary: Craftspeople — people who care about execution and want to work alongside the people already there.

quotes.text: We're looking for people who care deeply about quality of execution and who want to build technology that people love to use.
We know we're doing a good job of hiring so long as we see people continuing to join simply to work with those who are already here.

cards.summary: Movers — people who go fast, take on the big stuff, and have immediate impact.

quotes.text: We need help from people who like to move fast, tackle the big stuff, and have an immediate impact.
Come work alongside passionate individuals who are excited to learn and love what they do.

cards.summary: Ambitious strivers — big dreamers with grit, autonomy, and ambition.

quotes.text: We hire people who dream big, who have grit, autonomy, and ambition.
We believe your potential should only be limited by how big you can dream.

cards.summary: Mission-aligned optimists who must also be star performers — optimism early, high performance later.

quotes.text: We are building a team of smart, creative, passionate optimists, the kind of people who see opportunity where others see roadblocks.
We have high expectations for performance and delivering results, and thrive as a team of individual star performers.

cards.summary: The brightest, customer-obsessed, held to a relentlessly high bar.

quotes.text: We hire the world's brightest minds and offer them an environment in which they can relentlessly improve the experience for our customers.
Leaders have relentlessly high standards — many people may think these standards are unreasonably high.

cards.summary: Smart, driven, and mission-serious — engineers, not academics, judged by outcomes.

quotes.text: We're looking for smart, driven people.
You are not evaluated by distant executives — you are judged by outcomes.

cards.summary: The best — and openly self-selecting: if you're not a great match, you won't last.

quotes.text: We hire the best people and match their expertise to our most exciting work.
It's hard to work here if you're not a great match, and we want to ensure those who consider applying can thrive in our unique environment.

cards.summary: High performers who thrive on freedom — stunning colleagues on a team, not a family.

quotes.text: We hire unusually responsible people who thrive on this openness and freedom.
Our culture has helped us attract and retain stunning colleagues, making work here more satisfying.
